description: This file is a test configuration script for pytest, specifically defining fixtures and test collection modification functions. It is used to set up and teardown test environments and organize test execution order.

methods.name: setup_and_teardown
methods.description: A pytest fixture that reloads the 'litellm' module and 'litellm.proxy.proxy_server' if available, sets up an asyncio event loop, and performs teardown after test execution.

methods.name: pytest_collection_modifyitems
methods.description: Reorders pytest test items to group tests with 'custom_logger' in their parent name separately, likely for specialized test execution order.
